两项独立青少年研究互证。证据样本12-18岁，低龄儿童画人物常省略手部，4-10: Two independent adolescent studies support this observation. Samples were aged 12–18; younger children commonly omit hands, so observations at ages 4–10 need reduced weight.
OR最高但样本12-18岁；低龄儿童省略脚常见，注意发育混淆: The highest odds ratio came from ages 12–18. Omitting feet is common in younger children, so developmental differences matter.
夜晚意象。单特征不可触发预警，需与其他条目共现: Night imagery cannot trigger an alert alone; other evidence must co-occur.
云在儿童画中极常见，弱信号。注：Koppitz 体系将云列为焦虑指标，方向不一致: Clouds are very common in children's drawings. Different frameworks disagree on their direction, so this is treated as a weak signal.
房屋仅画一侧墙。Buck 框架中单线墙=情感压抑（经验级佐证）: Only one side of a house is drawn. The Buck framework supplies experience-based support, not independent validation.
树干无树皮细节。与'缺少细节'共享底层观察，同簇去重: A trunk without bark details shares an observation with limited detail; the same cluster is counted only once.
多源互证最强颜色信号。阈值0.6为策展标定，待Zhang et al. 2023: Several sources support this color observation. The 0.6 threshold is curator-set and awaits pixel-based calibration; individual color preferences should form the baseline.
与HTP-007同簇，簇内取max不重复计数: Shares a cluster with HTP-007; only the maximum weight is counted.
⚠️ 强发育混淆：低龄儿童天然画得简单。4-8岁命中必须降权，建议c因子额外×0: Strong developmental confounding: younger children naturally draw simply. Ages 4–8 require downweighting; an additional 0.5 factor was proposed.
面部表情缺失/无嘴合并观察: Combines observations of missing facial expression and an omitted mouth.
无动作/无互动元素。LLM提取此特征时主观性较强，注意c因子: No action or interaction is depicted. Extraction from a drawing is subjective and should be treated cautiously.
⚠️ 负证据：Joiner et al. 1996 未见显著关联；Thomas: Conflicting evidence exists: Joiner et al. (1996) found no significant link, and Thomas & Jolley (1998) noted subject-importance confounding. The source proposes a small-area threshold below one ninth of the page; its reported 73.33% single-feature accuracy is not Luma's accuracy.
'位置偏角落/底部=不安全感'无实证支持（Agent4全网检索结论），仅保留Li: The project's literature search found no empirical support for interpreting corner or bottom placement as insecurity. Retained only as a weak signal within the Li framework.
枯枝/断枝/枯根合并观察。Buck框架：枯枝=空虚绝望（经验级佐证）: Combines dead branches, broken branches and roots. The Buck interpretation is experience-based supporting material.
树干极细/单线树干合并观察: Combines very thin and single-line trunks.
底层观察是局部深黑，归入dark_color簇: The underlying observation is a dark local area; it belongs to the dark-color cluster.
⚠️ 与Yan et al. 2014冲突（雪/雨为保护性 OR=0.086）。: Conflicts with Yan et al. (2014), where snow/rain was protective (OR 0.086). Direction is disputed, so this qualitative item gets minimal weight.
⚠️ 与Yan et al. 2014冲突（修改/擦拭痕迹 OR=0.508 保: Conflicts with Yan et al. (2014), where revision marks were protective (OR 0.508). Repeated erasure must be distinguished from careful revision; the proposed threshold is at least three marks alongside line-quality observations.
与产品场景最接近的研究（自由绘画非指定主题）。留白比例可由server直接从图像: The study uses free drawing rather than assigned subjects, making its setting relatively close to this product. Blank-space ratio could be measured from the image.
⚠️ FBANet Fig5d将重笔触归为低落方向（定性）。方向有分歧，保守赋权: FBANet Fig. 5d associates heavy strokes with low mood qualitatively. Sources disagree on direction, so weighting is conservative; mutually exclusive with HTP-021.
与HTP-020互斥（压力不可能同时强和弱），不同簇不冲突: Mutually exclusive with HTP-020: strokes cannot be both heavy and light at once.
线条断续/颤抖。LLM从静态图判断颤抖有难度，注意c因子: Broken or shaky lines. It is difficult for a model to infer shakiness from a static image.
人物局部涂黑阴影。与低落组dark_color簇共享底层观察，跨组同簇需注意；阴: Dark shading on a figure shares the dark-color observation across groups. A larger quantitative study supports the worry-related direction; avoid double counting.
大屋顶为保护性信号。Yule Q换算0.71，保守取0.5: A large roof is treated as a protective signal. A Yule Q conversion of 0.71 is conservatively reduced to 0.5.
与HTP-009同簇两极。簇内按情绪组分别取max，不冲突: The opposite end of the same detail cluster as HTP-009. Maxima are computed separately within each tendency group.
原文为'雪/雨'合并条目，此处只取雪以规避与HTP-017雨的方向冲突: The source combines snow and rain. Only snow is used here to avoid the conflict with HTP-017.
高饱和暖色主导。Weng为成人样本，KIDO为儿童大样本，方向一致: Dominant saturated warm colors. Weng used adults and KIDO used a large child sample; their directions agree.
经验级证据，无定量实证。弱信号: Experience-based evidence without quantitative validation; a weak signal.
⚠️ Koppitz指标控制绘画成熟度后差异消失（Catte 1998），发育混: Catte (1998) found Koppitz differences disappeared after accounting for drawing maturity. Strong developmental confounding; minimal weight.
映射为共识级定性故列L2；阈值可用于CV自动提取。与HTP-012同簇两极: Mapped to tier 2 as a qualitative consensus. Its threshold could support computer-vision extraction; the opposite end of the same cluster as HTP-012.
